description: This file defines core components and functions for building the RetinaNet object detection model using Keras with TensorFlow backend. It includes functions for creating classification and regression submodels, feature pyramid network (FPN) layers, and assembling the full RetinaNet model, as well as functions for generating anchors and applying detection post-processing like NMS.

methods.name: default_classification_model( num_classes, num_anchors, pyramid_feature_size=256, prior_probability=0.01, classification_feature_size=256, name='classification_submodel' )
methods.description: Creates the default classification submodel for predicting class scores at each feature level.

methods.name: default_regression_model(num_values, num_anchors, pyramid_feature_size=256, regression_feature_size=256, name='regression_submodel')
methods.description: Creates the default regression submodel for predicting bounding box coordinates at each feature level.

methods.name: __create_pyramid_features(backbone_layers, pyramid_levels, feature_size=256)
methods.description: Builds feature pyramid layers (P3, P4, P5, etc.) on top of backbone layers for multi-scale detection.

methods.name: default_submodels(num_classes, num_anchors)
methods.description: Creates default regression and classification submodels used in RetinaNet training.

methods.name: retinanet( inputs, backbone_layers, num_classes, num_anchors = None, create_pyramid_features = __create_pyramid_features, pyramid_levels = None, submodels = None, name = 'retinanet' )
methods.description: Constructs the complete RetinaNet model combining backbone features, FPN, submodels, and anchors.

methods.name: retinanet_bbox( model = None, nms = True, class_specific_filter = True, name = 'retinanet-bbox', anchor_params = None, pyramid_levels = None, nms_threshold = 0.5, score_threshold = 0.05, max_detections = 300, parallel_iterations = 32, **kwargs )
methods.description: Creates a detection model that applies regression, classification, and bbox decoding with NMS to produce final detections.
